<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ord="http://example.com/orders">
  <soapenv:Header/>
  <soapenv:Body>
    <ord:UploadInvoice>
      <ord:OrderId>___ORDER_ID:1001___</ord:OrderId>
      <!-- payloadId is an attribute: it is not an attachment. The text of <ord:Data> is: cid:invoice-1001 is replaced by
           the Base64 of the file (or sent as a MIME part, with MTOM). -->
      <ord:Document payloadId="cid:invoice" contentType="application/pdf">
        <ord:Data>cid:invoice-1001</ord:Data>
      </ord:Document>
    </ord:UploadInvoice>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>
